channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: US gas reaches $4.30 per gallon; Trump says prices will drop after Iran war
item.description: Price of petrol in US jumps by nearly 30 cents in one week amid Strait of Hormuz blockade and Iran diplomatic deadlock.

item.title: Palestinians mourn football loving teenager killed by Israeli army
item.description: Mourners in Hebron laid to rest 16-year-old Ibrahim al-Khayatt who was shot in the chest by Israeli soldiers.

item.title: Hegseth testifies on Iran war before Senate committee: Key takeaways
item.description: Pentagon chief testifies alongside top general for second day, in first public Congressional hearings since war began.

item.title: Trump says Iran can play at World Cup in US after FIFA confirmation
item.description: FIFA chief Gianni Infantino has said Iran will play their World Cup matches, leading to agreement from US President.

item.title: Iran will play World Cup games in US according to FIFA chief Infantino
item.description: Iran's place at the US cohosted 2026 event has been in doubt since the US-Israeli war on their country.

item.title: Piracy rises off Somalia as US-Israeli war on Iran diverts naval forces
item.description: More than a dozen sailors, mostly from Pakistan, are being held by Somali pirates as hijackings and harassment surge.

item.title: Lebanese girl mourns paramedic father killed in Israeli strike
item.description: A young girl in Lebanon joined hundreds mourning her father, one of three paramedics killed in an Israeli attack.

item.title: UN chief calls for immediate reopening of the Strait of Hormuz
item.description: UN Secretary-General António Guterres has urged the immediate reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Oil price hits highest since 2022 after report Trump to be briefed on new Iran options
item.description: Axios reported that US Central Command has prepared a plan for a wave of "short and powerful" strikes on Iran.

item.title: Deadly Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon despite ceasefire
item.description: At least nine people - including two children - were killed, according to Lebanon's health ministry.
